'''Galactic Alliance Infantry Scouts''' were light [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Army]]. They wore [[Color/Legends|light blue]] [[Clothing/Legends|uniforms]], black [[Boot/Legends|boots]], orange [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]], and [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]]. Unlike the [[Galactic Alliance Infantry Trooper]]s, the [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] had virtually no [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="Legacy Campaign" />
